title: Gentle-shell PR dashboard
brief: Three static six-PR dashboard directions. All metadata is explicitly illustrative, not live GitHub status. Ledger is recommended.

artboards.title: The ledger (recommended)
artboards.tradeoff: Warm editorial overview with legible comparison rows; requires horizontal scrolling on small screens.

artboards.title: The status board
artboards.tradeoff: Kanban lanes make stages immediate; cross-PR comparison takes more scanning.

artboards.title: Operations focus
artboards.tradeoff: Dark compact overview prioritizes exceptions and density over spacious reading.
